City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 20, 2019 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-02-20 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Shelter Agreement between the City of Encinitas and the American Red Cross for use of the Encinitas Community and Senior Center for disaster relief. Contact Person: Center Manager Goodsell
Approve and authorize the City Manager to execute an ongoing Shelter Agreement between the City of Encinitas and the American Red Cross to provide facilities at the Encinitas Community and Senior Center for disaster relief.
2019-02-20 Item 08B American Red Cross Shelter Agreement
8C.
Public Works General Repair Services Spending Authorization Amendment for LC Paving and Sealing Inc. to construct the Leucadia 101 Interim Improvements. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute Contract Amendment #4 with LC Paving & Sealing, Inc. (LC Paving) in substantial form as attached, in the amount of $200,000 for general repair services to construct certain interim improvements on North Coast Highway 101, for a total not to exceed amount of $1,696,500 for the General Mobility Improvement Project (CS18E).
2019-02-20 Item 08C LC Paving Contract Amendment
8D.
Contract Amendments for As-Needed Civil Engineering and Project Management. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute amendments to the Latitude 33 Planning and Engineering, NV5, Inc. and STC Traffic, Inc. agreements, for as-needed civil engineering services, in additional amounts of $150,000 each, for total contracts not exceeding $450,000 each; and 2) Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to the Hoch Consulting agreement for as-needed project management services, in an additional amount of $150,000, for a total contract not exceeding $963,500.
2019-02-20 Item 08D Contract Amendments for As-Needed Civil Engineering and Project Management
8E.
Extension of Lease Agreement between the City of Encinitas and G.J. Trippe, Inc. dba Air Care International for the property at 1867 Mackinnon Avenue, Encinitas, CA. Contact Person: Risk & Safety Analyst Chapman
Authorize City Manager in coordination with the City Attorney to execute Amendment #1, Extension of the Lease Agreement between the City of Encinitas and G.J. Trippe, Inc. dba Air Care International for the property at 1867 Mackinnon Avenue, for two (2) additional one-year terms, upon mutual agreement.
2019-02-20 Item 08E Fire Station 2 Lease agreement
8F.
Consideration and possible Introduction of Ordinance No. 2019-05 amending Chapter 9.21 of the Encinitas Municipal Code to implement State regulations (via the Bureau of Cannabis Control) requiring Cities to authorize cannabis deliveries (not businesses) within their respective boundaries. Contact Person: City Attorney Sabine
Introduce Ordinance No. 2019-05 entitled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California amending Chapter 9.21 of the Encinitas Municipal Code to Authorize Cannabis Delivery (not businesses) pursuant to State Law.”
2019-02-20 Item 08F Amend Ordinance for Cannabis Deliveries Agenda Report for 2-20-19
8G.
Capital Project and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering projects and grants.
2019-02-20 Item 08G Mobility Projects and Grant Updates 2019-02-20
8H.
Authorization to continue to use U.S. Bank’s Voyager Fleet Card for Fuel Purchasing. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Authorize continued participation in the State of California’s Fleet Card program by approving the Participating Addendum No. 7-16-99-27 Amendment 1 with U.S. Bank National Association effective January 1, 2019 through December 31, 2020.
2019-02-20 Item 08H Voyager Renewal
8I.
License Agreement with the North County Transit District for the El Portal Undercrossing Project. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the License Agreement with North County Transit District (NCTD) (in substantial form as provided in Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the construction of the El Portal Undercrossing Project and ultimate maintenance of the improvements by the City.
2019-02-20 Item 08I El Portal MOU
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Discussion regarding the draft Housing Plan Update 2019 including further review and direction in response to the HCD 45-day Review Letter. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
Provide direction as appropriate related to the HCD 45-day Review Letter regarding the draft Housing Plan Update.
2019-02-20 Item 10A Housing Plan Update 2019
10B.
Review of the Draft Community Choice Energy Technical Feasibility Study. Contact Person: CAP Program Manager Najera
1) Receive the draft Community Choice Energy (CCE) Technical Feasibility Study (Attachment 1) and provide input; and 2) Direct staff to host a public workshop on the study, in coordination with the Partner Cities of Oceanside, Carlsbad and Del Mar, and return to Council with the final study and recommendations.
2019-02-20 Item 10B CCE Study Results
2019-02-20 Item 10B - Page 91 Corrected - February 19, 2019
10C.
Resolution 2019-17 amending the FY 2018-19 budget to extend the contract with EES Consulting, Inc. to cover the cost of evaluating Community Choice Energy (CCE) Governance options. Contact Person: CAP Program Manager Najera
1) Adopt Resolution 2019-17, titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget” (Attachment 1); 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to the cost share agreement between the cities of Encinitas, Del Mar, Carlsbad and Oceanside (Partners) or participating cities (in substantial form as attached) to share the additional cost for services in the amount of $54,500, plus $5,500 contingency, from EES Consulting, Inc (Attachment 2); and 3) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to the contract for services with EES Consulting, Inc. (in substantial form as attached) to cover the cost of evaluating Community Choice Energy (CCE) governance options for the Partners in an amount not to exceed $160,525 (Attachment 3).
2019-02-20 Item 10C CCE Contract Extension
10D.
Alternative Design Option for the North Coast Highway 101 Leucadia Streetscape Project (CS04D) and proposed San Diego Association of Governments Memorandum of Understanding. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Direct to staff to redesign the east side of North Coast Highway 101 to locate all parking to be parallel on-street; 2) Direct staff to develop a draft Memorandum of Understanding with the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) to establish the parameters for designing and potentially constructing the Coastal Rail Trail (CRT) project in conjunction with the Streetscape Project; 3) Direct staff to evaluate options for improving drainage conditions within the project boundaries; and 4) Direct staff to evaluate and return to the City Council with the costs (design and construction) and schedule associated with the project redesign and drainage improvements.
2019-02-20 Item 10D Streetscape Design Options
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - None
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - None
10B.
Review of the Draft Community Choice Energy Technical Feasibility Study. Contact Person: CAP Program Manager Najera
1) Receive the draft Community Choice Energy (CCE) Technical Feasibility Study (Attachment 1) and provide input; and 2) Direct staff to host a public workshop on the study, in coordination with the Partner Cities of Oceanside, Carlsbad and Del Mar, and return to Council with the final study and recommendations.
8I.
License Agreement with the North County Transit District for the El Portal Undercrossing Project. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the License Agreement with North County Transit District (NCTD) (in substantial form as provided in Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the construction of the El Portal Undercrossing Project and ultimate maintenance of the improvements by the City.
10D.
Alternative Design Option for the North Coast Highway 101 Leucadia Streetscape Project (CS04D) and proposed San Diego Association of Governments Memorandum of Understanding. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Direct to staff to redesign the east side of North Coast Highway 101 to locate all parking to be parallel on-street; 2) Direct staff to develop a draft Memorandum of Understanding with the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) to establish the parameters for designing and potentially constructing the Coastal Rail Trail (CRT) project in conjunction with the Streetscape Project; 3) Direct staff to evaluate options for improving drainage conditions within the project boundaries; and 4) Direct staff to evaluate and return to the City Council with the costs (design and construction) and schedule associated with the project redesign and drainage improvements.
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MARCH 13, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
